argument: For |z|<1, the power series for -log(1-z) is bounded in absolute value by |z|/(1-|z|).
Each local factor is bounded by 9 times p^(-1-delta)/(1-2^(-1-delta)).
Primes greater than L form a subset of the integers greater than L.
The decreasing-function integral bounds sum_(m>L) m^(-1-delta) by L^(-delta)/delta.
The bound tends to zero as L tends to infinity, uniformly on the declared closed right half-plane.
